mapper.sql: select t.trial_id, t.batch_id, t.trial_name, t.location_id, t.gps_location, t.season, t.year, t.design_type, t.replications, t.crop_type, t.variety_code, t.variety_name, t.create_time, t.update_time, t.create_by, t.update_by, t.is_deleted from trial_basic t
mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT('TR-', b.variety_code, '-', #{locationId}, '-', #{year}, '-', LPAD(IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.trial_id, '-', -1) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1, 3, '0')) FROM breeding_batch b LEFT JOIN trial_basic t ON t.trial_id LIKE CONCAT('TR-', b.variety_code, '-', #{locationId}, '-', #{year}, '-%') AND t.is_deleted = 0 WHERE b.batch_id = #{batchId} AND b.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY b.variety_code
